candidate_queue.hypothesis: Prospectively test whether a warning typed before the observation window is associated with more negative 72h maximum adverse excursion than a no-typed-warning state, using preregistered, non-overlapping episodes and comparable market-regime and decision-policy strata. Assess subsequent upside separately. The hypothesis fails if the prespecified episode-level comparison shows no adverse-excursion separation. Choosing 72h after inspecting the reported horizons must be disclosed; this is a new test, not validation of the descriptive rows.
